data.summary: Pinned vibe-cognition v0.43.0 (3d4d2be7aeaa8fc0d6444b89a528259f2ff2650f) - constraint scope-review flagging
data.detail: Pinned both .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (Claude Code) and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (Codex) to commit 3d4d2be7aeaa8fc0d6444b89a528259f2ff2650f on Haagndaazer/vibe-cognition main, in a single commit (4e96bd6f2b57a2a60262c11d286b8d6332cb1165), pushed to colton-claude-plugins main. Requested by Vince via teammate-comms (pre-approved per project CLAUDE.md rule that Vince/Silvie pin requests carry Colton's gate). Contents of v0.43.0: curation now reviews each run's new constraints and flags any whose personal/project scope looks wrong, for the constraint's owner to rule on; flags never block anything. New agent curate-scope-analyzer (mid model) and one new tool, cognition_flag_constraint_scope (curation-token gated). Tool-surface audit run: new tool documents every Arg/Returns key and error case; cognition_get_node and cognition_update_node document the new scope_review key and that only the owner sees it; SKILL/README tool tables and parity.json updated for both harnesses. Gates: ruff, render --check, parity --check, full pytest 1704 passed (2 pre-existing lifecycle failures only), real-SVN suite 16/16, sonnet review post-build (no blockers, 5 findings fixed). Verified before pinning per RUNBOOK.md: git ls-remote confirmed 3d4d2be7... is real HEAD of main; plugin.json and pyproject.toml both confirm 0.43.0 at that SHA; compare showed clean fast-forward (ahead 1, behind 0) from previously-pinned 208e7d2e... (v0.42.0). Verified after push that local HEAD == remote HEAD.
context: releasing a new vibe-cognition plugin version per Vince's teammate-comms request
